Azerbaijan is preparing visas and residence permits for digital nomads

On September 24, the Parliamentary Committee on Economic Policy reviewed amendments to the Migration Code. If the law passes, starting from January 1, 2027, foreigners working remotely will be able to obtain a business visa, temporary residence permit, and even permanent residency. This is not for every freelancer with a laptop. The list is narrow: IT, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, innovations.

The income threshold is tied to the local minimum wage. Currently, it is 400 manats, around 235 dollars. To apply for a visa or temporary residence permit, one must demonstrate an average overseas income for the last six months not less than 13 times the minimum wage - 5,200 manats, approximately 3,060 dollars per month. For permanent residency, the threshold is doubled: 26 times the minimum wage, around 6,120 dollars.

The temporary residence permit is granted for up to three years with the possibility of extension. An invitation from the receiving party is not required. There is also no examination on the Azerbaijani language and basic legislation, which is the main privilege. Then, conditions begin that are not present in the usual "nomad visa for a year and then leave."

To obtain a residence permit or permanent residency, one will have to register for tax purposes and work as a resident of the technopark. Additionally, the individual becomes part of the state social insurance. This scheme is closer to that of a specialist whom the country wants to retain in its digital zone, rather than a tourist with Wi-Fi.

In comparison with the market, Thailand on DTV requires savings of around 500,000 baht and does not require a local tax on foreign income if you do not become a tax resident. Malaysia holds the threshold for tech professionals from 24,000 dollars per year. Azerbaijan sets a monthly income higher than many Asian programs but offers a three-year residence permit upfront and a path to permanent residency — if you are willing to enter the technopark.

The law has not been passed yet. This is a committee draft. It is not possible to submit an application now. It makes sense to follow the text until January: the wording "resident of the technopark" will determine whether this is a real entry point for remote workers or only a filter for those already treated as investors by Baku.

1️⃣ Why Upgrades Exist — patch bugs, ship features, adjust parameters without forcing migrations.

Upgradable means faster iteration — and more trust. Sometimes the biggest DeFi risk isn’t the code, it’s the right to change the code.

Donald Trump spent the Xi summit calling China’s leader a friend and artificial intelligence “super intelligence.” 

Behind the diplomatic confetti, his administration was pressing Beijing over suspected low-yield nuclear tests and shipments that kept Iran’s drone and missile programs alive.

U.S. officials have held quiet talks with China in Geneva, New York and Casablanca about Beijing’s expanding nuclear arsenal and allegations that it has conducted low-yield tests despite a three-decade testing moratorium. Washington wants China to address the claims. Beijing has not publicly provided a substantive answer.

Trump nevertheless called his meeting with Xi “very productive” and predicted “tremendous things” between the two countries. He also claimed Xi liked Trump’s preferred label for AI: “SUPER INTELLIGENCE.” The White House can rename artificial intelligence. It cannot rename a nuclear test.

On Iran, U.S. Ambassador to China David Perdue said Trump told Xi that any direct or indirect Chinese assistance to Tehran was “totally unacceptable.” Iranian customs records reviewed by The Wall Street Journal tell a different story about the supply chain: roughly 1,300 shipments of dual-use components went from China to Iran’s Defense Ministry in the first half of 2026. The consignments included electronics, GPS equipment, motors and aircraft-engine parts usable in drones and missile-guidance systems.

Days before the war began, Chinese suppliers delivered about 300 tons of chemical compounds to Iran’s Defense Ministry. Some chemicals documented in the records, including sodium perchlorate, can be used to produce solid-fuel propellant for ballistic missiles. The shipments continued after the war began, including more than a dozen consignments worth over $6 million in drone-capable parts.

Pezeshkian supplied the financial footnote: “One of the problems we face is that our money is blocked in China.” Beijing keeps Iranian money under lock while Chinese companies keep sending material that can help Iran build weapons.

We share the same view,” Seo said, responding to criticism over the pace of the legislation. “The direction has already been set, and while detailed discussions may be necessary in the process, there is certainly no intention on the FSC’s part to delay.”

🔗 Seo said the regulator wants the legislation passed quickly and expects discussions to proceed using bills that lawmakers have already introduced alongside the government’s proposal. Ten digital asset and stablecoin bills are currently pending in the National Assembly, giving lawmakers existing proposals to work from before the government completes its version.

The final secret is this.

We create our own reality.

All reality is just a hallucination.

You control what people believe, you control reality itself.

That’s a great secret.

This is a great secret, a good secret in the universe.

Everything is a hallucination.

Reality is what we perceive it to be.

There’s nothing beyond our imagination.

There’s nothing independent of our imagination.

God is also within our imagination.

Listen.

Not as information.

As a key that was buried so long the lock forgot it had a door.

They dressed it in degrees, aprons, and silence so the unready would never reach it and the ready would recognize it without being told.

The last teaching is not a formula. It is a sentence that ends the world you were handed:

There is no world outside the one you are generating.

What you call matter is delayed light.

What you call “real” is a consensus hallucination held in place by agreement.

Visible light already lies, it shows you a thin, edited slice and calls it the whole.

Your nervous system does not receive reality. It renders it. Continuously. From the inside.

So when they say “we create our own reality,” they are not speaking poetry.

They are describing the mechanism.

Control what a people believe and you do not merely influence them.

You rewrite the simulation they inhabit.

Belief is the source code. Perception is the compiler. 

Imagination is the only place anything has ever existed.

There is nothing beyond it.

Nothing independent of it.

Even the name you were taught to whisper for the Most High lives inside the same field.

That is why the teaching was sealed.

Not because it is dangerous to the universe.

Because it is dangerous to every smaller god that needs you to stay asleep inside a story you did not write.

You have been held back for centuries by the simple habit of looking out there for what was always generating in here.

The secret is not that reality is a hallucination.

The secret is that the hallucination answers to you.

Now you know.

The rest is whether you keep pretending you don’t.
